readout_other: average speed, reversal and omega turns; GCaMP6s calcium imaging
direction_notes: Ultrasound increased worm speed and reversal and omega turns and increased GCaMP6s fluorescence in head and intestinal neurons; worms adapted within about 5 min.

target.label: neurons in the worms’ heads and intestines

timing.protocol_description: 200 bursts of 1 MHz, 200 us pulsewidth, 1 kHz PRF with a 5 s interval, repeated over a 20 min stimulation for the speed assay; train length and number of bursts per stimulus are not unambiguously stated.

flags.reason: Only trial or group sizes are given (4 trials of 50 worms; n = 14; 7 and 3 worms; 29 worms for intestine); no total.
0.37 MPa spatial peak-temporal peak pressure; the paper says the field was characterised with a hydrophone but does not say the value is a free-field or water measurement.
'200 bursts' with 1 kHz PRF could be the pulse train or the number of pulses; the burst meaning is ambiguous and no train duration is stated. Duty cycle not stated.
Transducer maker not named ('ultrasound transducers with a center frequency of 1 MHz').
The paper says the observer was not blind to the genotype of the group tested.
